sql: SELECT "wine"."No" AS k, (CAST("wine"."Price" AS REAL) / "wine"."Score") AS m1 FROM "wine" WHERE (CAST("wine"."Price" AS REAL) / "wine"."Score") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: wine.bottle price per critic rating score
why: bottle price / critic rating score: the catalogue declares bottle price a rate over critic rating score
rank wine rows by bottle price per critic rating score
